name: Spiders' Hunting Pit

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters

disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to deconstruct the webbing or DC 20 Acrobatics check to pull the webbing apart without getting trapped or hit by rocks.

items.name: Pitfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature that isn't a spider walks onto the webbing

---
Effect The triggering creature falls in, taking 2d10+13 bludgeoning damage with a DC 20 basic Reflex save save from rocks tumbling into the pit.

text: Loose debris covers a patch of what appears as solid ground in a 10 feet by 5 feet area. It's actually covering thin webbing strung over a 20 foot pit.
